name: smwgraphics-super-metroid-station-room
title: Super Metroid - Station Room
description:
Background from the station rooms in Super Metroid. It uses palette 1 and one ExGFX file in BG1.

This download contains five different variants of the palette from the game.

This background would be most useful for a laboratory-themed level or for single-screen rooms (no vertical or horizontal scroll).

Credit is not needed, but it would still be appreciated.
